_comment: Code smells and anti-patterns detectable via static analysis (no AI needed).

god-class.name: God Class
god-class.description: A single file with too many responsibilities
god-class.suggestion: Split into smaller classes with single responsibility

god-method.name: God Method
god-method.description: A single method/function that is too long
god-method.suggestion: Extract smaller methods with descriptive names

deep-nesting.name: Deep Nesting
deep-nesting.description: Code nested more than 4 levels deep
deep-nesting.suggestion: Use early returns, extract methods, or use guard clauses

long-parameter-list.name: Long Parameter List
long-parameter-list.suggestion: Use a parameter object or builder pattern

file-class-mismatch.name: File-Class Name Mismatch
file-class-mismatch.description: File name does not match the primary class/module defined in it
file-class-mismatch.suggestion: Rename file to match the primary class

inconsistent-naming.name: Inconsistent Naming Style
inconsistent-naming.description: Files within the same role use different naming styles
inconsistent-naming.suggestion: Standardize naming within each architectural role

circular-import.name: Circular Import
circular-import.description: Two or more modules import each other creating a cycle
circular-import.suggestion: Break the cycle using dependency inversion or an interface

layer-violation.name: Layer Boundary Violation
layer-violation.suggestion: Use a port/interface from the correct layer instead

orphan-file.name: Orphan File
orphan-file.description: File that is not imported by any other file in the project
orphan-file.suggestion: Remove if unused, or ensure it's properly imported

empty-catch.name: Empty Exception Handler
empty-catch.suggestion: Log the error or handle it appropriately

hardcoded-secret.name: Hardcoded Secret
hardcoded-secret.description: Credentials or tokens hardcoded in source code
hardcoded-secret.suggestion: Move secrets to environment variables or a secret manager

sql-injection-risk.name: SQL Injection Risk
sql-injection-risk.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements

no-lockfile.name: Missing Lockfile
no-lockfile.description: Package manifest exists but lockfile is missing
no-lockfile.suggestion: Generate lockfile to ensure reproducible builds

no-gitignore.name: Missing .gitignore
no-gitignore.suggestion: Add a .gitignore appropriate for your language/framework

test-without-assertion.name: Test Without Assertion
test-without-assertion.description: Test function that has no assert, expect, or should statement
test-without-assertion.suggestion: Add assertions to verify expected behavior

todo-fixme.name: TODO/FIXME Comments
todo-fixme.description: Code contains TODO or FIXME markers that may indicate incomplete work
todo-fixme.suggestion: Track in issue tracker instead of code comments

console-in-production.name: Console/Print in Production Code
console-in-production.description: Debug output left in production code
console-in-production.suggestion: Use a proper logging framework instead
